notes.title: Great Pilots version 1.03
notes.notes:
Great Pilots v1.03 is now live!  

In this update, we have updated sound effects that now sound more like realistic gun fire and explosions!

Have fun playing! 

Can you finish all 40 levels???

Great Pilots will challenge you!!!

notes.title: Great Pilots updated to version 1.02
notes.notes:
Great Pilots has now been updated to version 1.02

What did we do?

1. Added parallax effect to background images to create a sense of depth

2. Balanced some earlier levels to smooth out difficulty progression
   --> some players noted there was a sharp increase in difficulty

3. Increased the challenge of the final three levels
  --> Both player airplanes are faster and more capable
  --> The opposing forces are better and more numerous....

Good Luck!!!

notes.title: First Update: Version 1.01
notes.notes:
- All Airplanes are now smaller and more proportional to ground targets.
- All Player Airplanes are proportionally faster.
- All Player Airplanes turn more quickly making it easier to loop around.

These updates are based on player feedback.

Have fun!
